Format insights as:
```
[LEARN]
insight: <key learning>
context: <when this applies>
```

[LEARN]
insight: Same task "No tests detected" repeatedly created and completed - the Inter-Review system generates identical tasks on a loop without solving the underlying issue
context: When review system creates tasks that don't address root cause
[/LEARN]

[LEARN]
insight: 792 PAUSED tasks remain stuck - system generating new tasks while old ones accumulate, creating parallel backlog problem
context: Active task processing coexists with massive paused backlog
[/LEARN]

[ISSUE]
title: Inter-Review creates infinite loop of identical suggestions without solving underlying issue type: bug severity: high
[/ISSUE]

[PROMPT_UPDATE]
insight: Inter-Review should analyze whether prior suggestions were addressed before creating new ones, or disable auto-creation for low-value generic suggestions
context: When review system creates repetitive tasks
[/PROMPT_UPDATE]
